summary: systemd scope (system, user, global) requires a user dbus and XDG_RUNTIME_DIR for user units; state options started, stopped, restarted and reloaded (which starts if stopped).
questions: How do I manage a systemd user service with Ansible?
Why do I get Failed to connect to bus with scope user?
Does reloaded start a stopped unit?

answer_card.title: systemd scope and state
answer_card.answer_md:
- `scope`: `system` (default), `user`, `global`. User scope needs the user's dbus; set `XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/<uid>` or you'll get "Failed to connect to bus".
- `state`: `started`/`stopped` idempotent; `restarted` always; `reloaded` always (starts if not running).
